description: This file defines the interface class IGstWebAudioPlayerClient for the Rialto GStreamer web audio player. It declares a pure virtual method notifyState to notify the client of changes in the web audio player's state, such as IDLE, PLAYING, PAUSED, or EOS.

classes.name: IGstWebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: An abstract base class that provides an interface for clients to receive notifications about the web audio player's state changes.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Pure virtual method to notify the client of the current web audio player state.
